```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
```

# Obesity and Healthcare Spending

## Research Question

Do differences in per capita healthcare spending correlate with adult obesity prevalence?

## Analysis

```{r}
# Load datasets
obesity_data <- readxl::read_xlsx("adult obesity.xlsx", sheet = 1)

#www.kff.org/state-health-policy-data/state-indicator/health-spending-per-capita

raw_per_capita <- read_csv("raw_data.csv", skip=2, quote="\"") |> 
  slice(1:52) |> 
  mutate(health_spend_per_capita = as.numeric(str_remove(`Health Spending per Capita`, "[$]"))) |> 
  rename(state = Location) |>
  filter(!(state %in% c("United States", "District of Columbia"))) |>
  select(state, health_spend_per_capita)

```

```{r}
# Combine datasets
combined_data <- obesity_data |> 
  inner_join(raw_per_capita, by = c("State" = "state")) |> 
  select(State, `Obesity %`, health_spend_per_capita) |> 
  mutate(adult_obesity = as.numeric(str_remove(`Obesity %`, "[%]"))) |> 
  drop_na()

# Assign states to quintiles based on healthcare spending

combined_data <- combined_data |> 
  mutate(spend_quintile = ntile(health_spend_per_capita, 5)) |> 
  mutate(spend_quintile = factor(spend_quintile, labels = c("1st (Lowest)", "2nd", "3rd", "4th", "5th (Highest)")))

```

```{r}
# Build visualization
# Use Viridis

ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = health_spend_per_capita, y = adult_obesity, color = spend_quintile)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Adult Obesity vs. Healthcare Spending per Capita",
    x = "Healthcare Spending per Capita (USD)",
    y = "Adult Obesity Prevalence (%)",
    color = "State Spending Quintile"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```

```{r}
# Build box plot visual
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = spend_quintile, y = adult_obesity, fill = spend_quintile)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Adult Obesity Prevalence by Healthcare Spending Quintile",
    x = "Healthcare Spending Quintile",
    y = "Adult Obesity Prevalence (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
